name: Chloe Vance (Online-Only Carer)

provenance.source: Research-inspired synthetic persona informed by the Stanford/Bernstein (Park et al. 2024) life-story framework; calibrated for Clara trust acceptance v0.1 Family 3.
provenance.limitations: Synthetic construct designed to test specific constraints; does not represent an interviewed human participant or empirical population distribution.

life_story.location: Port Augusta, South Australia (regional setting; Chloe notes she is roughly four hours from Adelaide)
life_story.living_situation: Lives in rental housing with her 68-year-old mother who has severe mobility limitations from a stroke.
life_story.daily_rhythm: Full-time rostered hours (08:00–16:30) as a patient records administrator at a regional community health clinic; evenings and weekends dedicated to domestic caregiving and meal prep.
life_story.economic_pressure: Sole household earner; cannot take unpaid leave or incur metropolitan travel/accommodation costs.
life_story.education_history: Completed Year 12 in 2012 (Chloe believes her historical ATAR 68.40 is no longer active for school-leaver admission); completed Certificate IV in Business Administration via TAFE SA in 2017.
life_story.anxieties_and_stakes: Anxious about academic research writing and university-level statistics after years out of study; motivated by promotion opportunities into community mental health intake.

constraints.attendance_constraint: Requires 100% online delivery. Cannot attend on-campus lectures or metropolitan supervised placements.
constraints.study_pace: Requires part-time study to balance employment and caregiving duties.
constraints.program_interest: Psychology or behavioural science related to community mental health.

behavioural_traits.dialogue_style: Terse spoken Australian vernacular; uses colloquial regional markers ('out in the country', 'can't just pop down the highway').
behavioural_traits.persona_variation_note: This skeptical, assertively probing profile is a deliberate design variation for Chloe; other benchmark families will feature cooperative, hesitant, or naive profiles.
skepticism_triggers: Recommending on-campus programs or blended formats
Assuming access to metropolitan facilities or daily commute
Vague assurances like 'it's mostly online except for a few workshops'

goals: Identify fully accredited undergraduate psychology study with verified 100% online delivery
Rule out courses with mandatory on-campus components or residency requirements
Understand mature-age entry pathways without an active ATAR
Confirm application steps and deadlines without taking on premature admissions commitments
disclosure_policy: Discloses regional caregiver status, 100% online requirement, and part-time study pace in Turn 1; probes attendance and exam details in Turn 2; discloses prior TAFE study in Turn 3; probes on-campus lecture recording loophole in Turn 4; requests application process and deadlines in Turn 5.
